meta.title: Martín Barreiro — Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Martín Barreiro, fullstack web developer. Experience, projects and contact.

sigillum.description:
I work as a full stack developer on a platform in the cosmetics sector, where I have taken on more and more responsibility. I help define the structure of the application and I am solely responsible for design and user experience, from the interface to complete user flows.

My strongest contribution is on the frontend with Angular, but I also work on the backend with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL and help on projects that extract data from public sources. That way I take each feature from idea to production.

marosavat.description: I built dynamic, efficient interfaces with Angular for applications that manage and present tax returns, in collaboration with the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT).

pinvestiga.description: I collaborated on the new version of the pInvestiga software with Angular and NestJS, implementing a real-time chat, data libraries and forms.

nonchoperdas.description: A social network and forum to discover and share events. Personal project in development.

about.intro: I'm Martín, a full stack developer with a passion for design. I was born in Galicia {age} years ago and I like what I build to work well and look polished too.
about.outside: I have competed in kayaking at national level since I was 16. From my father I inherited a love for music and the sea.
about.seek: To consolidate my knowledge and keep growing as a full stack developer, contributing to your projects and ideas.

daw.title: Higher Diploma in Web Application Development
daw.description: I gained solid foundations in object-oriented programming and became familiar with Symfony and Vue. On the backend I learned to build Docker containers to deploy my projects.

asir.title: Higher Diploma in Networked Computer Systems Administration
asir.description: I learned about the management and deployment of servers with Docker and Apache, as well as working with SQL databases. This is where I discovered programming.
